description: API théorique et temps réel is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Accédez aux horaires planifiés et temps réel des trains SNCF ainsi qu'au moteur de calcul d'itinéraire. L'API SNCF est accessible sur. Coverage: France. The portal files it under Horaires et itinéraires. Its keywords are API, Horaires, Temps réel. The portal shows 2023-04-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is https://www.digital.sncf.com/startup/API/conditions-generales-dutilisation-de-lapi-sncf. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
